## English

Waifu2x Desktop 1.0.3 extends the minimum macOS version to **macOS 13.0**, including Ventura 13.0–13.3.

- Rebuilds the same ONNX Runtime **1.23.2** for macOS 13.0, preserving CPU, CoreML, and WebGPU
- Keeps the existing models and their checksums unchanged
- Adds compatible window controls, dragging, settings access, toolbar styling, and animation fallbacks for older systems
- Preserves immediate language changes, image queues, canvas position, and model repair progress with the compatible observation system
- Checks the minimum system version of every bundled executable and runtime during release packaging

**Apple Silicon (arm64), macOS 13.0 or later**

[Download DMG](https://github.com/SteveTanSaMa/Waifu2x-Desktop/releases/download/v1.0.3/Waifu2x-1.0.3-macos-arm64.dmg) · [Download ZIP](https://github.com/SteveTanSaMa/Waifu2x-Desktop/releases/download/v1.0.3/Waifu2x-1.0.3-macos-arm64.zip)

The app manages model downloads and repairs automatically. Images are processed locally. Compatible app updates use a smaller incremental download, with a verified complete ZIP as fallback.

Validation includes unit tests, CPU/CoreML/WebGPU inference with a small test graph, signed bundle checks, and deployment-target checks. Physical testing on macOS 13 hardware is still pending.

The app uses an ad-hoc signature and is not Developer ID signed or notarized. If macOS blocks the first launch and you trust the download, use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.

## 简体中文

Waifu2x Desktop 1.0.3 将最低系统版本扩展至 **macOS 13.0**，覆盖 Ventura 13.0–13.3。

- 为 macOS 13.0 重新编译相同版本的 ONNX Runtime **1.23.2**，保留 CPU、CoreML 和 WebGPU
- 现有模型及其校验值保持不变
- 为旧系统补齐窗口控制、拖动、设置入口、工具栏外观与动画回退
- 使用兼容的状态观察机制，保留即时语言切换、图片队列、画布位置和模型修复进度
- 发布打包时检查每个内置程序及运行库的最低系统版本

**支持 Apple Silicon（arm64），要求 macOS 13.0 或更高版本**

[下载 DMG](https://github.com/SteveTanSaMa/Waifu2x-Desktop/releases/download/v1.0.3/Waifu2x-1.0.3-macos-arm64.dmg) · [下载 ZIP](https://github.com/SteveTanSaMa/Waifu2x-Desktop/releases/download/v1.0.3/Waifu2x-1.0.3-macos-arm64.zip)

应用会自动管理模型下载与修复，图片在本机处理。满足条件时使用更小的应用增量包，否则回退到经过校验的完整 ZIP。

已完成单元测试、小型模型的 CPU/CoreML/WebGPU 推理验证、应用签名及最低系统版本检查，尚未在 macOS 13 真机上实测。

应用使用 ad-hoc 临时签名，未使用 Developer ID 签名，未经 Apple 公证。若 macOS 阻止首次打开，且你信任此下载，可通过“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 仍要打开”启动。
